structure.unit: Forest Resources and the Department of Forestry

law.text:
The provisions of this article shall not prohibit:
Any person from performing forestry functions and services so long as he does not represent himself to the public as a forester;
An employee or subordinate of a forester from performing forestry functions and services; or
The practice of any profession or occupation that is regulated by a regulatory board within the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation or other state agency.
